city_served.value: Bluffton, SC is served; it is also the business base (SAB based in Bluffton, SC 29910).
city_served.source: Brand Guide E (all 12 towns confirmed, Paul 2026-10-06); Brand Guide A4

local_context.value: Humid subtropical climate, hot summers; hurricane threat in summer and early fall; elevation about 20 ft; May River runs through the centre of town, New River on the southwest boundary. Old Town is a National Historic District (1996, 46 contributing buildings) with antebellum homes from the 1800s; population grew from 1,275 (2000) to 27,716 (2020), so much of the housing stock is recent. No client-specific roof failure patterns recorded.

neighborhoods.value: Inside the Town of Bluffton: Old Town, Palmetto Bluff, Jones Estate, Buckwalter, Shultz Tract, Hampton Hall. Also served, outside the Town limits (Greater Bluffton): Belfair, Colleton River Plantation, Moss Creek.
neighborhoods.source: Paul 2026-10-09 (settled bluffton_communities); Town of Bluffton Neighborhoods PDF; Wikipedia Bluffton

things_to_do.value: May River; Oyster Factory / Bluffton Oyster Co (opened 1899); Old Town Bluffton historic district.

top_sites.value: Church of the Cross (built 1854-1857); Heyward House (open to the public since 1998); Old Town National Historic District.
